description: Conservative policy for the PrivacyDrive classroom prototype

public.description: No blocking privacy signal was detected.

personal.description: Personal identifiers may be processed locally or by the explicitly trusted edge.

restricted.description: Highly sensitive or explicitly confidential content must remain local.

uncertain.description: Ambiguous or unsupported content remains local pending review.

assumptions: Classification occurs on the client before any remote transmission.
The edge worker is trusted by the prototype threat model.
Cloud is not trusted to receive personal or restricted raw document content.
Uncertain content uses the conservative local-only fallback.
